Two horses together pull three times the weight, not two.

Kevin explains that when two people work as a team, there is a synergy neither has alone.

He says it is strongest in a romantic couple, when both are pulling for each other in tandem. He calls it an unstoppable force.

Who is pulling the wagon with you?

#ad #love #relationships #success

No carbon, no steel. No persistence, no character.

Kevin shares Napoleon Hill's idea that persistence is to character what carbon is to steel: the most important element.

He says most people fail because they stop making new plans when the old ones fail. Ray Kroc did the opposite and stayed committed to his goal, not to one venture.

What plan did you drop too soon?

#ad #success #mindset #goals

Shoot for the moon, even when dreams don't always come true.

Kevin explains that missing the moon still lands you among the stars. That is why he says you have to have a dream.

He says a dream gives life to your soul and, most of all, adds life to your years.

What dream would get you out of bed tomorrow?
